relationships.kozo-kazamatsuri: Co-conspirator in trying to control Rebellion and preserve the postwar balance.

relationships.stella-vermillion: One of the young fighters whose generation defeats the Tokyo future he feared, though her abduction confirms a deeper threat.

periods.summary: Tsukikage accompanies Kazamatsuri's group to the Rebellion base so his history-reading ability can confirm what happened and protect the Tyrant. Captured by Abraham and Arlanz, he deduces that the United States intends to declare itself justice and start war by blaming the League alone for Rebellion's manipulation. He withstands brainwashing and refuses to become a traitorous witness even when Rinna and Sara are tortured. After Ouma and Nango rescue the captives, Tsukikage collapses on the return trip. In Tsushima he remains trapped in prophetic nightmares: even after Japan defeats the US fleet, he warns Kazamatsuri that the true disaster has not yet begun.

key_events.summary: Identifies the US plan as a war pretext built on one-sided justice.
Refuses Arlanz's demand that he testify as a League conspirator.
Collapses during the flight home and later warns that the nightmare is not over.
